description: This file declares the interface for a dynamic array (vector) implementation in C, providing functions for creation, destruction, manipulation, and querying of vector objects, including support for custom cleanup and comparison functions.
external_methods: rtError rtVector_RemoveItem(rtVector v, void* item, rtVector_Cleanup destroyer)
rtError rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare, rtVector_Cleanup destroyer)
int rtVector_HasItem(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare)
void* rtVector_Find(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare)

methods.name: rtVector_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a vector instance and optionally cleans up its items using the provided destroyer function.

methods.name: rtVector_PushBack
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the vector, optionally cleaning up the item.

methods.name: rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare
methods.description: Removes an item based on a comparison function.

methods.name: rtVector_At
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified index.

methods.name: rtVector_Size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_HasItem
methods.description: Checks if an item matching the comparison exists in the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_Find
methods.description: Finds and returns an item matching the comparison criteria.
